title: Eva's Lab
description:
Eva's Lab is a first-person puzzle game developed independently by an individual. You will play Eva who wakes up in the laboratory. Under the guidance of artificial intelligence Omega, you use the force field gun in your hand to solve puzzles one by one, leave the laboratory, gain freedom, and understand the real purpose of the laboratory and the story behind Omega.

Gameplay introduction:Players get a force field gun in the level, click the left mouse button to launch the blue force field, the blue force field emits a repulsive force field from the energy center, which can make the player jump higher, and can also interact with the scene bouncy balls, lasers, etc., turn on switches or pass obstacles.

Click the right mouse button to launch the red force field, the red force field emits a suction force field from the energy center, which can attract players or scene bouncy balls, lasers, etc., turn on switches or pass obstacles.

The force field gun can be recycled by the clear key and re-fired to get a better position.

Blue repulsive force field and red gravitational force field

Mouse emits blue and red force fields

The game levels progress from shallow to deep, and there are rich levels for players to challenge. Players need to use their brains to think, use force field guns flexibly, generate force fields at appropriate locations, and solve puzzles;

At the same time, you can search for and collect elements and enjoy the fun of solving puzzles.
